name: Kanbayashi Yuzu
source:
A wealthy spoiled girl her family is almost as influential as the Shinomiya group that [url=https://vndb.org/c37107]Aoi[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c37106]Mashiro[/url] are heirs to.

[url=https://vndb.org/c37102]Shizuku[/url] is her maid. Although she acts coldly toward Shizuku because of their different status she loves her very much even offering herself as a replacement should [url=/c37107]Aoi[/url] and [url=/c37106]Mashiro[/url] target her. She is bad when it comes to sexual topics and is also conscious of her small boobs.
